requirements.text: The portal should allow patients to book, cancel, and reschedule appointments online.
Patients should be able to request repeat prescriptions online without needing to call the clinic.
There must be a clear pathway for patients to contact support staff for assistance with any issues or questions that arise while using the portal.
Security measures must be implemented to protect patient information and ensure that only authorized personnel can access it.
The portal must comply with data protection regulations to maintain patient privacy and foster trust in the online system.
